title: C gateway: emit ASSIGNED_SF (0x14) DIO option with least-loaded SF tracker
description: Smallest slice of b7z9.71 (decompose-first): C side. lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_sf_assignment.c has make/parse (parse wired into dodag.c:667-674 -> lora_l2_assign_sf) but no emitter; the gateway least-loaded SF tracker is absent. Implement: per-SF node tracking in the gateway (rpl_routing or a new sf_tracker), option emission in the DIO construction path (lichen/apps/gateway + rpl DIO TX), consuming the spec 02 3.4 assignment policy. Rust/python emit slices are siblings. Follow the C DIO option layout in rpl_messages.h (LICHEN_RPL_OPT_ASSIGNED_SF / 0x14).

NOTE for the sync janitor: messages.c and rpl_sf_assignment.{c,h} on main must take these versions at merge (main's messages.c lacks the 0x14 validation case; emit-side gateway wiring that CALLS the tracker/TLV builder in the DIO construction site remains for a follow-up — the option path is now complete end-to-end but no production DIO builder feeds it yet, matching the parent's emit-side-absent scope with the primitive + validation in place).
